title: Mr Bean's Apple Snaps
description: Spiced apple cookies topped with thin apple slices, sprinkles, and warm autumn spices.
ingredients: 2 tsp Ground cinnamon, plus more for topping if desired
White cake sprinkles or coarse sugar
steps: Preheat the oven to 180C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, sift together the flour, ginger, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, baking powder, cloves, and salt. Set aside.
In an electric mixer, cream the butter on medium speed until light in colour.
Add the sugar and brown sugar, then beat for 3 minutes.
Add the molasses and mix until combined.
Add the whole egg and egg yolk, then beat on medium speed until fully blended.
Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture in three parts, mixing carefully on low speed until fully blended.
Working in batches as needed, roll 2 tablespoons of dough into balls and flatten them by hand on the prepared baking sheet to about 1/4 inch high, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Slice the apples as thinly as possible crosswise so the star of the core shows in the middle, remove any seeds, and press the slices firmly into the centre of each cookie.
Sprinkle cake sprinkles and extra cinnamon evenly over the cookies.
Transfer the baking sheet to the refrigerator or freezer for 5 minutes to chill the dough and prevent the cookies from spreading too much.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, or until the edges are golden and the cookie does not look wet under the apple slice.

title: BEST Air Fried Chips
description: A quick air fryer chip recipe with cornstarch for extra crispiness.
steps: Cut the potato into chip-sized pieces.
Microwave the potato on high for 7 minutes.
Mix the potato with the seasoning, egg white, and cornstarch until coated.
Air fry at 200C for 15 minutes, shaking or mixing halfway through.

title: Greek Sheet Pan Chicken
description: A bright one-pan chicken dinner with lemon, herbs, zucchini, tomatoes, olives, and feta.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Olive oil (or reduce to 1/4 cup)
1/2 Large red onion, thinly sliced into wedges
1 packet Cherry or grape tomatoes (halved if not tiny)
steps: Preheat the oven to 220C.
Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, thyme, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Place the chicken in a large bowl and pour over two-thirds of the marinade. Toss well to coat, then let it sit for 10 to 15 minutes.
Spread the zucchini, red onion, and tomatoes onto a baking sheet. Drizzle over the remaining marinade and toss to coat.
Arrange the chicken on the baking sheet with the vegetables.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Add the olives and feta, then bake for another 10 to 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
notes: If the chicken looks very pale, switch to fan-forced for the last 10 minutes. The method text mentioned chicken thighs, but the ingredient list specified chicken breasts, so this version follows the ingredient list.

title: Chicken Crust Pizza
description: A high-protein pizza with a chicken mince crust, simple tomato sauce, and classic sweet-salty toppings.
ingredients: Chilli flakes, Italian herbs, oregano, pepper, and garlic powder, to taste
steps: Mix the nutritional yeast, cottage cheese, chicken breast mince, and garlic powder to make the pizza crust mixture.
Press the chicken mixture into a pizza shape.
Mix the tomato paste, olive oil, water, chilli flakes, Italian herbs, oregano, pepper, and garlic powder to make the sauce.
Spread the sauce over the crust.
Top with salami, pineapple, and mozzarella.
Bake until the chicken crust is cooked through and the cheese is melted and golden.
notes: Total nutrition provided: 940 kcal and about 150g protein. The source also listed two different per-serve calorie values, so this recipe uses 470 kcal per serve with 75g protein and keeps the original discrepancy noted here.

title: Deli-style marinated chicken breast
steps: Marinate chicken for 30 minutes to 3 hours.
Preheat oven to 200C convection.
Place chicken breast onto a lined baking tray and place the butter cube on top.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until internal temperature reaches 75C.
Rest for 10 minutes.
Slice thinly against the grain.
Toss together with sauce.

title: Simmered hijiki salad
steps: Soak the hijiki, rinse with water, and drain.
Drain the thin fried tofu and cut it into thin strips.
Heat a pan and quickly cook the hijiki over high heat.
Stir-fry, then add the thin fried tofu and dashi stock and simmer for about 2 minutes.
Add the sugar and simmer for about 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and mirin in that order, cover with a drop lid, and simmer until soft.
Add edamame if using.

title: Chinese sauteed wombok
ingredients: 2 Tbsp light soy sauce (or soy sauce)
1/2 tsp dark soy sauce (or soy sauce)
steps: Combine the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and stir to mix well.
Cut cabbage into bite-size pieces by halving, then quartering. Slice off the stem. Separate outer leaves and chop the thicker center into smaller pieces.
Add oil and Sichuan peppercorns into a large skillet and heat over medium heat. Cook until the peppercorns turn dark but not burned. Scoop out and discard.
Add the chili peppers and garlic. Stir a few times to release fragrance.
Add cabbage. Stir and cook until the leaves just start to turn tender.
Stir the sauce again to dissolve the cornstarch, pour into the pan, and cook until cabbage is tender but still crisp and the sauce thickens.
Turn off heat, taste, and adjust seasoning if needed. Drizzle with sesame oil and stir to mix.
Serve hot as a side dish.

title: Healthy chicken and leek pie
description: Fits in an IKEA container or glass pie dish.

title: Korean tofu pancakes
ingredients: 1 low sodium chicken stock cube, crushed (or half full sodium)
steps: Whisk tofu, potato starch, and chicken stock powder.
Add veggies.
Add sauce.
Fry on medium heat with a lid. Do not press down too much.
Adding a little water helps the top cook so it is easier to flip.

title: Miso edamame risoni
ingredients: garlic and shallot or red onion
low sodium vegetable stock (keep topping up)
steps: Cook garlic and shallot (or red onion) in olive oil.
Add risoni and toast briefly.
Add low sodium vegetable stock, topping up as it absorbs.
Stir in tahini and edamame.
Blend kale with white miso paste and a splash of water, then stir through.
Finish with lemon. Add suggested additions if using.

title: Healthy banana bread
steps: Bake at 175C for 30 minutes.

title: Pork & prawn dumplings
ingredients: 1 pack dumpling wrappers (30, will have a little filling leftover)
steps: Steam for 10 minutes or until cooked throughout.

title: Korean mayak (drug) eggs
steps: Boil eggs for 7 minutes.
Combine soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, shallot, garlic, onion, and chilli.
Add eggs to marinade in a container, cover eggs with paper towel so the marinade touches.
Leave overnight.
Serve over rice with the marinade.

title: Chicken karaage
ingredients: 1 garlic clove, grated (2 cloves for 3 people)
1 tsp chicken stock powder (or cube, crushed)
steps: Mix the sauce ingredients and marinate chicken in the fridge for a while.
Coat with corn flour.
Heat sunflower oil to 170C in a medium saucepan (about 1 inch deep).
Fry 4 to 5 pieces at a time until golden brown.
Remove to paper towel, return oil to 170C, and repeat.
Serve with mayo and spring onion.

title: Zappakanka
steps: Bake at 180C for 30 minutes.

title: Cinnamon protein granola
description: Makes 4 serves (484 Cal | 24g protein). Lightly sweetened, minimal oil, and cinnamon-forward.
ingredients: 6 Tbsp nut butter (half almond, half peanut)
steps: Cook at 150C for 20 minutes, mixing halfway.
